--[ Route 1 ]------------------------------------------------------------------
Prefix     | new_user_session
Verb       | GET
URI        | /users/sign_in(.:format)
Controller | devise/sessions#new
--[ Route 2 ]------------------------------------------------------------------
Prefix     | user_session
Verb       | POST
URI        | /users/sign_in(.:format)
Controller | devise/sessions#create
--[ Route 3 ]------------------------------------------------------------------
Prefix     | rails_health_check
Verb       | GET
URI        | /up(.:format)
Controller | rails/health#show
--[ Route 4 ]------------------------------------------------------------------
Prefix     | dashboard
Verb       | GET
URI        | /dashboard(.:format)
Controller | dashboard#show
--[ Route 5 ]------------------------------------------------------------------
Prefix     | api_users
Verb       | POST
URI        | /api/users(.:format)
Controller | api/users#create
--[ Route 6 ]------------------------------------------------------------------
Prefix     | api_users
Verb       | GET
URI        | /api/users(.:format)
Controller | api/users#index
--[ Route 7 ]------------------------------------------------------------------
Prefix     | api_user
Verb       | GET
URI        | /api/users/:id(.:format)
Controller | api/users#show
--[ Route 8 ]------------------------------------------------------------------
Prefix     | api_user
Verb       | PATCH
URI        | /api/users/:id(.:format)
Controller | api/users#update
--[ Route 9 ]------------------------------------------------------------------
Prefix     | api_user
Verb       | DELETE
URI        | /api/users/:id(.:format)
Controller | api/users#destroy
